title: 基于概念瓶颈的扩散模型视觉反事实解释
summary: 提出C-VCE框架，将分类器直接嵌入扩散模型的概念瓶颈层，通过可解释概念引导反事实生成，避免依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器。支持语义概念开关、最小化图像修改，并保持特征相关性。在CelebA等基准上实现更高翻转率且失真更小。
summary_en: Introduces C-VCE, a diffusion framework that embeds a classifier via a concept bottleneck layer, enabling counterfactual generation guided by human-interpretable concepts without relying on separate noise-robust classifiers. Achieves higher flip rates with less distortion on benchmarks like CelebA.
